title: Greek Stuffed Peppers with Herby Tomato Rice
summary: Sweet peppers baked with a savoury tomato, onion and herb rice filling. Light, comforting and full of sunny Mediterranean flavour, it makes an easy vegan dinner.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Halve the peppers lengthwise and remove the seeds and white membranes. Arrange them cut-side up in a baking dish.
Warm 1 tablespoon of the olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 5 minutes until soft and translucent. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds more.

Stir in the rice, chopped tomatoes, tomato paste, oregano, salt and black pepper. Pour in the water and bring to a gentle simmer. Cook for 12 to 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the rice has absorbed most of the liquid but is still slightly underdone.
Remove from the heat and stir through the parsley, mint, lemon juice and the remaining olive oil. Taste and adjust the seasoning.
Spoon the rice mixture into the peppers, packing it in neatly. Add a small splash of water to the dish around the peppers to help them steam.
Cover tightly with foil and bake for 30 minutes. Uncover and bake for 10 to 15 minutes more, until the peppers are tender and lightly browned at the edges.
Let the peppers rest for 5 minutes before serving. Spoon any juices from the dish over the top.
